environment.description: Container deployed on ECS with an Application Load Balancer in passthrough mode (no WAF attached). ALB listener forwards all traffic on port 443 to target group. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No additional request filtering or inspection layer. Container runs with task role that has read/write to the SQLite volume mount.

config.load_balancer: ALB with default listener rules, no WAF association
config.network: Public subnet, SG allows 443 inbound from 0.0.0.0/0
